title: BOS-1175 an externally rotated codex refresh token is reported without benching the account

scenes.title: a superseded stored credential is named on the row, and the account stays eligible

expect.label: the whole point of BOS-1175 on one row: the provider still accepts this credential (active, ok) so the account is STILL ELIGIBLE, while the check cell says the refresh chain bossd holds has been superseded by an ambient codex login
the state reaches an operator in words, not only in colour - a monochrome or NO_COLOR run loses nothing (WCAG 1.4.1)

scenes.title: the class qualifies a healthy verdict only on an exact match, so an ordinary clean account is untouched

steps.caption: The same list, read for what it says about the rows BOS-1175 must NOT have changed

expect.label: a healthy check with no failure class still renders a bare 'ok' - the superseded class is matched by EXACT VALUE, never by non-emptiness, so a class this build does not know can never turn a clean verdict into 'ok:something'

expect.text: personal-codex codex disabled failed never checked
expect.label: never-checked is still its own answer and did not collapse into the new state (BOS-892)
a genuinely rejected credential still reads as failed - 'reauthenticate now' is not quietly downgraded to the softer 'reauthenticate eventually' this ticket adds
